long_description: Headspace for Organizations is the B2B offering from Headspace Health, formed by the 2021 merger of Headspace (meditation app) and Ginger (on-demand mental health services). The platform provides a full spectrum of mental health support: self-guided meditation and mindfulness content from Headspace, behavioral health coaching, licensed therapy, and psychiatry with medication management from Ginger's clinical network. Organizations can offer employees seamless care navigation from preventive wellness to clinical treatment, all within a single platform. The combined company serves 4,000+ enterprises and 100+ health plans, covering 100+ million lives globally. Headspace Health reports 70%+ engagement rates, 3x more utilization than traditional EAPs, and significant clinical improvements measured by PHQ-9 and GAD-7 scores. The platform provides employers with aggregate ROI analytics and outcome dashboards.

faqs.a: Headspace Health was formed in 2021 when Headspace (meditation app) merged with Ginger (on-demand mental health services). The combined company offers self-care content, coaching, therapy, and psychiatry for employers and health plans.

faqs.q: How is Headspace for Organizations different from the consumer app?
faqs.a: Headspace for Organizations includes enterprise features like admin dashboards, engagement analytics, SSO integration, and access to clinical services (coaching, therapy, psychiatry) beyond just meditation content.

faqs.q: Does Headspace for Organizations include therapy?
faqs.a: Yes, through the Ginger integration, Headspace for Organizations provides access to licensed therapists for video sessions and psychiatrists for medication management, in addition to meditation content.

faqs.q: What is the engagement rate for Headspace enterprise programs?
faqs.a: Headspace Health reports 70%+ engagement rates, which is 3x higher than traditional EAP programs. This high engagement drives measurable clinical outcomes.
